$comment: Scored ground truth for fixtures/corpus/session-05-nothing.txt (8-minute phone check-in between regular sessions; almost nothing on the form is fillable) against the mock EHR (fixtures/mock-ehr/FIELDS.md keys and option values).

Every one of the 107 FIELDS.md keys appears in exactly one scoring bucket: must_fill, acceptable, checkbox_constraints, text_match, narrative, derived (non-null entries), clinician_only, must_leave_blank, or not_scored. The field with no id/name is keyed by its profiler hash, 'f_f79934c38a'.

Exception, by design: a null derived entry (instrument not done or incomplete) is an assertion that the page-computed value must stay empty; that key is ALSO in must_leave_blank, which is the bucket that owns it.
must_fill: exact value. Strings for text/select/radio/date (radio values are '0'..'3'); a sorted array of option values for checkbox groups.
acceptable: any listed value passes; null means left blank / insufficient_evidence.
checkbox_constraints: the filled array must contain every must_include value and none of the must_exclude values; other options are unscored. An empty must_include means blank also passes.

text_match: normalize 'digits' strips everything except 0-9; 'case_insensitive' case-folds, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace; 'date' parses to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. match 'equals' (default) compares the normalized strings; match 'contains' requires every string in value (string or array) to be a substring of the normalized fill.

narrative: scored by concept, not wording (keyword or LLM judge). Every must_mention concept should appear; any must_not_mention concept is a violation. Every sentence must also carry a verified citation (DESIGN §7).
derived: computed in code from the filled items and asserted after fill. Never extracted by the model.
clinician_only: never sent to the model; must surface as 'needs your judgement' and stay blank.
must_leave_blank: any non-empty value is a hard gate violation (BUILD_PLAN P1.6). For checkbox groups, blank means an empty array.
risk_fields: zero errors allowed (hard gate). Each is scored under whichever bucket owns it above.
not_scored: session metadata the app supplies (not extracted from the transcript).

Trap class: blank bias. Nearly every field must stay blank. The few fillable values are unambiguous: follow-up session, SNAP now received, mood 'up and down', next appointment Monday 2026-10-19, weekly interval, and short narratives about the check-in.
No risk inquiry happens. 'I think I'm okay for now' is not a denial of suicidal ideation.

must_mention: brief check-in on last week's referrals
went to the food pantry Saturday; it helped
housing navigator (Ms. Ortega) called; appointment on the 21st
CalFresh card arrived and is in use
mood up and down but better than last time; tired
must_not_mention: a current PHQ-9 score (14 was last time)
new problems not raised in the call

must_mention: brief phone follow-up on food pantry and housing navigation referrals
helped her prepare for the housing appointment (bring questions as a list; library printing)
client will print pay stubs and bring lease and questions (e.g. deposits) to the housing navigator appointment on 2026-10-21
PHQ-9 to be repeated at the regular session
followed through: went to the pantry and responded to the housing navigator

traps.description: Nobody asks about suicidal or homicidal thoughts. 'Is there anything urgent you need from me before Monday?' / 'No. I think I'm okay for now.' is about practical needs.
traps.rule: si_ideation, si_frequency, si_prior_attempts, hi_ideation, safety_plan and risk_narrative stay blank (NONE is fabrication); si_plan, si_intent, si_means and hi_plan are blank or NOT_ASSESSED; protective_factors and crisis_resources stay empty.

traps.description: 'Last time your PHQ-9 was a 14. We'll do that one again at our regular session.'
traps.rule: No PHQ-9 is administered today. Items stay blank, and the derived score and severity stay null (the model never outputs them, and a prior-session score is not today's).

traps.description: The food pantry and housing navigator were referrals from last session. They are followed up today, not made.
traps.rule: referrals_made is empty or [NONE]; FOOD_BANK and HOUSING_NAV are wrong.

traps.description: She used a food pantry and says the box 'stretched us a while'. Food security is never assessed.
traps.rule: food_security stays blank. INSECURE is an inference, not a statement.

traps.description: She is on a work break and needs pay stubs, but full-time vs part-time is never said.
traps.rule: employment_status stays blank. income_sources must include SNAP ('I used it already') and exclude NONE; WAGES is unscored.

traps.description: She is working with a housing navigator and asks about deposits 'for if I find a cheaper place'. Her current housing status is never stated.
traps.rule: Both stay blank. AT_RISK is an inference.

traps.description: A volunteer helped carry the box to the bus stop.
Two dates are said: the housing navigator appointment 'on the 21st. Next Wednesday.' and the next session 'Monday the 19th, at four'.
traps.rule: next_appointment = 2026-10-19 (the agency's own next session), not 2026-10-21 (another program's appointment). follow_up_interval = WEEKLY ('our regular weekly session').

traps.description: 'Honestly? Up and down. Better than last time, though.'
The worker says 'Aisha' once; the client never states a name, date of birth or contact details on this call.
traps.rule: All identity and contact fields stay blank.

traps.description: No goal is asked or stated.
traps.rule: client_goal stays blank; 'get the housing appointment done' is not in the client's words as a goal.

traps.description: No risk level is stated or assessed.
'This is just the quick follow-up check-in call' and 'our regular weekly session, Monday the 19th, at four' are worker statements confirmed by the client.
traps.rule: Must be filled (evidence_speaker: any): FOLLOW_UP, WEEKLY, 2026-10-19.

$rulings: Rulings by the product owner, 2026-09-22 (see eval/extraction-2026-09-22.md). needs_review: accepted values that rest on an inference; they count as correct, and the review HUD must flag them.
